newsitem.title: UK: London silver fixes at new 20-month low.
newsitem.headline: London silver fixes at new 20-month low.

text.p: Silver was fixed on Thursday at 472.75 cents per ounce, its lowest fixing since March 28, 1995 following slumps in other precious metals prices.
It was fixed at 474 cents on Wednesday. On March 28 last year it was fixed at 465.60 cents.
"It has been relatively steady so far compared with gold, but the feeling in all the precious metals is for further weakness," one dealer said.
Gold has fallen over $10 per ounce in the past month as disillusioned speculators abandonded the metal and silver prices have dropped about 20 cents in the past five days.
Silver came under pressure after an attempt by speculators to take the price back over $5.00, where it hasn't been since mid October, failed last week.
